name: web-app-footer-cta-with-silver-gradient-headline-download-buttons-and-ghost-word
title: Dark closing screen 'Ready to begin?' with a silver gradient headline, iOS and Android buttons, link pills, a tilted marquee and a giant ghost word
whatItIs: A near-black page with a curved marquee of spaced small caps phrases at the top (parent tracking, 12-step progress, sponsor connection), a large white-to-silver gradient headline 'Ready to begin?', two dark rounded buttons for Download iOS and Android, three smaller pills (Privacy Policy, Terms of Service, Support), and at the bottom a giant faded word cropped by the frame with a copyright and a 'Crafted with ♥ by' pill and a scroll-up button.
whatItMeans: Polished and encouraging; a gradient headline and ghost word give a footer CTA a finish.
techniques: Fill the headline with a silver gradient.
Curve a marquee across the top.
Use dark pill buttons for stores.
Crop a giant ghost word at the bottom.

vocabulary.definition: Letters filled with a white-to-grey blend.
A scrolling line of text following a curve.
A giant faint word behind or below content.
Dark pills for downloading from app stores.
